intro: Elemental War is a task undertaken for Tsunaman, an envoy of the water elementals residing at Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains. Guided by the will of Neptulon the Tidehunter, adventurers are sent into the scorched depths of the Charred Vale to extinguish blazing fire elementals and collect their smoldering Incendrite cores. It provides a rare glimpse into the ancient, perpetual rivalry that divides the elemental planes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.
Friend, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.
